### `DisplayWidth`

```csharp
int DisplayWidth { get; }
```

*read-only*

Width of the image as it should appear on the page, accounting for EXIF orientation. For orientations 5-8 (90 degree/270 degree rotations) this is the stored height, since the image was captured rotated.

### `IccProfile`

```csharp
byte[] IccProfile { get; set; }
```

Embedded ICC colour profile, uncompressed. Populated from JPEG APP2 `ICC_PROFILE\0` segments and from PNG `iCCP` chunks. When non-empty, the writer emits a PDF `/ICCBased` colour space referencing a dedicated stream object so the image renders with its captured colour transform instead of falling back to the device colour space.

> A list you can change.

### `InvertCmykColors`

```csharp
bool InvertCmykColors { get; set; }
```

True for Photoshop-exported CMYK JPEGs (Adobe APP14 marker with transform=0), where ink values are stored inverted. The writer maps this to PDF `/Decode [1 0 1 0 1 0 1 0]` so the colours render correctly.

### `KeepResolution`

```csharp
bool KeepResolution { get; set; }
```

Set by the placing element: embed this image at its source resolution, whatever the document's resolution cap. Not part of the decoded image.

### `Orientation`

```csharp
int Orientation { get; set; }
```

EXIF orientation (1-8) read from JPEG APP1 metadata. 1 is "natural" (no transform); 5-8 are rotations/flips that swap width and height for display. PNGs and JPEGs without EXIF default to 1. The canvas applies the matching placement matrix so the image renders upright without re-encoding the pixel stream.
